NOTIFICATION
ln continuation to Commission's result Notification No. PSC-R(B)/\6/2020 Dated
23'd May, 2022 it is to inform that Commission has fixed the date for Viva-voce for the post of
Research Officer under the Department of Finance, Planning & lnvestment Govt of Arunachal
Pradesh ltanagar on 17th June, 2022 at APPSC Office, ltanagar.
The candidates are directed to upload the self-attested copy of the following
documents in pdf format not exceeding 1Mb in size through their respective login lD in the
Commission's website www.dppsc,qov.in on or before 10th June, 2022, 1600 hours from issue
of this notification:
1. Matriculation Certificates (Class X) issued by Board for proof of Date of Birth.
2. Class Xll Certificate and Marksheet.
3. Bachelor of Degree Certificate and Marksheet.
4. Master Degree Certificate & marksheet issued by Assistant
Registra r/Registrar/Controller of Exam ination/Vice-Chancellor of the concerned
University to ascertain Educational Qualification.
5. APST Certificate for APST Candidates.
6. lntimation letter to HoD for those who are in regular Govt. service/NOC.
Further, the Candidates are directed to download their admit cards w.e.f. 4th June,
2022 onwards from commissions website www.op psc.gov.in u pto 16th June'2022 till 1600 hours.
